annotations.title: Browse the jobs OffLadder covers, by field

description: Lists the jobs OffLadder has written about in one field of work, for someone who wants ideas or wants to see what exists before choosing one, e.g. 'what jobs are there in healthcare besides being a doctor', 'list careers in tech', 'what trades could I go into', 'creative jobs I could look at', 'public service careers', 'jobs in education that aren't teaching', 'what kinds of jobs are there'. Fields: health (Health and care), tech (Tech, data and AI), money (Business, office and finance), creative (Creative, media and design), trades (Trades, energy and transport), science (Science, engineering and land), public (Law, government and safety), education (Teaching and education), service (Service, hospitality and travel). Each job comes with what has been written about it (whether it suits you, how to get in, where it is heading, what AI changes, what people move on to) and a link. Without a field it lists the fields with how many jobs each holds. 228 jobs in all. It lists kinds of work, not open vacancies.
